rendered.overview: This Jeskai-leaning five-color deck builds around [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]], chaining waterbend, earthbend, firebend, and airbend effects from Lesson spells to draw cards and eventually transform him for a burst of life, cards, counters, and damage. Allies, Shrines, and earthbend triggers add a wide battlefield, while a backup loop with [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] and either Aang creature can generate infinite ETB and LTB triggers.

weaknesses: Moderate: Only [[Origin of Metalbending]] answers artifacts or enchantments, so a resolved threat like a hypothetical board wipe lingers.
Moderate: With just two interaction cards and only one at instant speed, a fast combo from an opponent can resolve before [[It'll Quench Ya!]] is ready.
Moderate: Removing [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] cuts off the main draw engine and the transform payoff entirely.

avatar aang // aang, master of elements.name: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

plans.primary: Cast [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] and trigger all four bending types each turn to draw cards and transform him for a huge upkeep payoff.
backups: Assemble [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] or [[Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury]] with [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] and [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] for infinite creature ETB and LTB triggers.

Allies, Shrines, and earthbend triggers add a wide battlefield, while a backup loop with [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] and either Aang creature can generate infinite ETB and LTB triggers.

strategy.text: Cast [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] around turn 3 and start triggering bending abilities with Lesson spells.
Use [[Earthbender Ascension]] and [[The Boulder, Ready to Rumble]] to earthbend lands into creatures while ramping.
Stack all four bending triggers in one turn to transform [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] for the big upkeep payoff.
As a backup, land [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] alongside [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] or [[Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury]] to loop infinite triggers.
Lean on [[Sanctum of Calm Waters]] and other Shrines to keep refilling your hand while the board develops.

keep.text: A hand with early mana and [[Earthbender Ascension]] to fix lands and ramp.
Lands backed by a Lesson spell to start feeding [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]].

sendBack.text: A fixer with nothing to cast after it stalls out.
A hand missing enough colors to reliably cast [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]].

tips.text: [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] airbends your own creatures, letting you recast [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] cheaply from exile for more triggers.
[[Toph, Hardheaded Teacher]] earthbends lands whenever you cast any spell, turning extra Lessons into bigger land-creatures.
[[Guru Pathik]] puts counters on creatures whenever you cast a Lesson, Saga, or Shrine spell like [[Sanctum of Calm Waters]].

assessment.line: Only [[Origin of Metalbending]] answers artifacts or enchantments, so a resolved threat like a hypothetical board wipe lingers.
With just two interaction cards and only one at instant speed, a fast combo from an opponent can resolve before [[It'll Quench Ya!]] is ready.

The deck has no fog or pillowfort effect, so a fast combat race can overwhelm it before [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] transforms.
Removing [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] on its ETB window stops the infinite loop with [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] cold.
